title: poc(chat): add product modal with navigation
body: **Summary** [FX-3510](https://algolia.atlassian.net/browse/FX-3510) This PoC: - Adds an interactive product modal that displays detailed product information when the carousel action is clicked. - Implements keyboard navigation support (arrow keys to navigate between products and the Escape key to close). - Includes action buttons for viewing product details and adding products to favorites. - Adds animations and transitions for modal interactions. - Ensures the design is responsive. **Result** [FX-3510]: https://algolia.atlassian.net/browse/FX-3510?atlOrigin=eyJpIjoiNWRkNTljNzYxNjVmNDY3MDlhMDU5Y2ZhYzA5YTRkZjUiLCJwIjoiZ2l0aHViLWNvbS1KU1cifQ
